📺 Power Book IV: Force (2022–2026)

Power Book IV: Force follows Tommy Egan, one of the most feared and unpredictable figures in the Power universe, as he leaves New York City behind and attempts to build a powerful new criminal empire in Chicago. After losing some of the most important people in his life, Tommy arrives in the Windy City determined to start over on his own terms, bringing his ruthless ambition, street intelligence, and fearless personality into unfamiliar territory. However, Chicago’s criminal underworld is already controlled by powerful organizations, dangerous drug dealers, and influential families unwilling to surrender their territory. As Tommy begins establishing connections and expanding his operation, he quickly becomes involved in violent rivalries, complicated alliances, and dangerous power struggles that threaten his survival. His growing influence attracts attention from established crime bosses, ambitious rivals, and law enforcement officers determined to bring down the city’s drug networks. Along the way, unexpected family revelations, personal relationships, and betrayals force Tommy to confront difficult decisions about loyalty, trust, and the price of ambition. With every new opportunity comes another enemy, pushing him into increasingly dangerous situations where one wrong move could destroy everything he has built. Through explosive confrontations, shocking twists, emotional conflicts, and intense criminal negotiations, Tommy proves that he is willing to risk everything to become Chicago’s most powerful player. Combining gritty action, suspenseful storytelling, and unforgettable characters, Power Book IV: Force explores power, revenge, loyalty, betrayal, survival, and the relentless pursuit of control in a dangerous criminal world.

🎭 Genre: Crime • Drama • Action • Thriller

⭐ IMDb: 8.1/10

⏱️ Runtime: Approximately 50–60 minutes per episode • TV-MA

🎥 Creator: Robert Munic

📺 Where to Watch: STARZ in the United States. Availability varies by region.

source_details.synopsis: Power Book IV: Force, or simply Force is an American crime drama television series created by Robert Munic that premiered on February 6, 2022, on Starz. The series is a sequel and third spin-off to Power created by Courtney A. Kemp. In March 2022, the series was renewed for a second season, which premiered on September 1, 2023. In December 2023, the series was renewed for a third season. In June 2024, it was announced that the third season will be the final season. The third and final season premiered on November 7, 2025.
